contexts.text: Hence what was unleavened, in which there was not what is fermented, is called the bread of affliction.
Its being unleavened, or not fermented, = its being sincere, and thus from a sincere heart, and without uncleanness.

He baked unleavened things () = purification, Bread = all celestial and spiritual food... and that these should be without impurities was represented by unleavened bread; for leaven = what is evil and false, by which celestial and spiritual things are rendered impure and profane. Therefore... they were commanded not to offer any other bread, or meat-offering, than what was unfermented, or unleavened. Illustrated.
So with what is unleavened, which = what is holy of love, or the holy of holies (). Therefore unleavened bread = pure love; and the baking of what is unleavened = purification. AC 2343.
And unleavened things () = what is purified from all falsity.
Unleavened bread = such good (as the good of innocence).
Ye shall eat unleavened things () = purification from falsities.
Ye shall observe unleavened things () = that there must be no falsity.
Ye shall eat unleavened things () = the appropriation of truth by good when the truth is purified from falsity. Explained.
This state is signified by the unleavened things...
In all your dwellings ye shall eat unleavened things () = that in the interiors, where good is, truth shall be appropriated... To eat unleavened things = to appropriate truth to themselves.
They baked the dough which they had brought forth from Egypt into unleavened cakes () = that from the truth of good there was again produced good in which there was nothing of falsity. Explained.

Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened things () = purification from falsities... To eat unleavened things = the appropriation of truth, and purification from falsity; for what is unleavened = good purified from falsity. (This is) because bread = good; and leaven = falsity. AC 8060. ( = a holy state then from the appropriation of Divine truth which has been purified from evil and the falsities of evil. AC 10656.)
Unleavened bread, like the manna, = good pure from falsities. For a like reason this bread is called the bread of misery ().
The feast of unleavened things () = purification from falsities.
Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened things () = worship and thanksgiving on account of purification from falsities... This feast is called also the passover. AC 10655, Signified, Explained.
And bread of unleavened things () = the purification of the Celestial in the inmost man. Explained.
The reason what is unleavened = what is purified, is that leaven = falsity from evil. Explained.
And cakes of unleavened things mixed with oil () = the purification of the middle Celestial. Explained.
And wafers of unleavened things anointed with oil () = [the purification] of the Celestial in the external man. Explained.
Out of the basket of the unleavened things () = (from the external Sensuous in which the purified goods are together).
